title: The sounds are great, pictures are excellent - but clock is SMALL!
text:
The sounds are great, pictures are excellent - but clock is SMALL!. We purchased this clock as a replacement for a standard wall clock at our office. The bird sounds are great and totally realistic. The photos are wonderful.

BUT... if you are looking for a wall clock with good readablilty from a distance then this is NOT the clock for you. I did not notice that it was 8" when I made the purchase. For our requirements, it should be at least double that size. I did not realise it was quite so little. Its much smaller that I would have thought without taking out a tape.

However, for a home or cabin?? an excellent choice.
